name: stalkchain
description: Crypto research in plain English: check a coin before you buy, vet a trader before you copy them, see what smart money is buying, and look up any wallet. Read-only.

interface.longDescription: StalkChain gives ChatGPT live crypto research data. Check a coin before you buy it: who holds it, whether the creator is selling, whether its liquidity is locked and its volume is real. Vet a trader before you copy them: their real wallets, profit, positions and track record. See which coins several top traders bought in the last hour, and look up what any wallet holds and how old it is, across Solana, Ethereum, Base, BNB Chain, Monad, Hyperliquid and Robinhood Chain. StalkChain only reads public data: it never trades, moves funds or signs anything. You need a StalkChain account with credits.
